name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v5.85: hardens app-release publishing. Publish now echoes the re-read stored release (so any store discrepancy is visible in the response, not just what was sent) and enforces forward-only versioning: a new release must have a strictly higher targetVersionCode than the current one for that app, rejecting the stale-version-with-new-APK mistake that silently disables the client rollback net. The rollout halt/resume handler now targets the correct app line (coil vs fridge) instead of always the coil release. Cumulative over v5.84.
